context: Whole group goes hiking together to see autumn leaves; multi-voice excitement.
purpose: Big family outing celebrating autumn changes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: The autumn leaves are such a fine colour, aren't they.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Warm and content. Voice settles into each word like he's savouring the sight. Quiet, patient Kansai cadence. Slight trailing-off, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええ景色や、来てよかった!
lines.en: What a beautiful view — I'm so glad we came!
lines.style: Bright, brassy energy from the start. Full-bodied Kansai warmth. Delighted, animated. Leans into the joy without hesitation. Quick pace, open vowels.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Wow — the leaves are so red!
lines.style: Pure, unselfconscious wonder. Sharp intake on the opening. Bright and awed. Speaks quickly but not rushed — the breathless speech of a child noticing something that stops him. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft, genuine awe. Opening word carries her full attention. Warm and earnest without performing. Slight lift at the end — she's discovering it as she says it. Younger register, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet, almost meditative. Gentle observation, not statement. Warm undercurrent of peace. Slow pace, slight pause before the second phrase. Tender noticing — the kind that suggests she's been quiet for a moment already.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm so happy we could come as a family.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth. Genuine fondness beneath calm delivery. Opens with quiet conviction. Unhurried, deeply felt. The contentment of someone who doesn't need to perform his happiness — it's just there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Autumn really is a special season, isn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, measured pace. Warm Kansai inflection. Quiet conviction — not lecturing, just observing something true. Settles into the final phrase. Gentle, almost wistful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: こうやって歩けて、ありがたい。
lines.en: To be able to walk like this — I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried opening. Humble tone — not self-pitying, just genuinely grateful for the ordinary moment. Kansai warmth. Soft, patient pacing. Warmth in the gratitude, not forced.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Everyone has to come back next year too!
lines.style: Animated, brassy energy. Loud Kansai aunt certainty. Commitment in her voice — this is a promise she's making for the group. Quick, bright delivery. Generous and bossy in the same breath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, earnest child-voice. Soft underneath but firm on the promise. Quick, warm delivery. Pride in being included in an adult promise. Small, genuine laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: These memories are treasures, aren't they.
lines.style: Tender, soft opening. Genuine affection underneath. Younger register. Gentle warmth — noticing something true without needing to perform the moment. Slight trailing-off, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Right now, my heart is so full.
lines.style: Soft, vulnerable opening. Warm, grateful tone. Slow, deliberate pacing — she's feeling this as she speaks it. Tender without fragility. The quiet revelation of someone who doesn't often say what she needs.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 人生、こんな時間が宝や。
lines.en: Life — these moments are what make it treasure.
lines.style: Soft, philosophical Kansai warmth. Unhurried, deeply felt. Opening carries gentle weight. Quiet conviction, not lecturing. Warmth beneath — the contentment of someone who has learned this truth slowly.
